Insights & recommendations · August 2026
Insights
1
Cost efficiency
Cost per lead and cost per subscriber moved together this month, to RM13.86 and RM76.81 respectively. Conversion held steady at 18.1%, so efficiency is tracking lead cost directly rather than a shift in the funnel.
2
Lead channel mix
WhatsApp Messaging remained the main driver this month, contributing 203 leads, 76% of the total. FB / IG DM was this month's biggest mover, down 42. Worth a quick check on whether that pullback was deliberate.
3
Conversion funnel health
Conversion held at 18.1% this month, in line with 18.8% last month. With the funnel stable, any change in subscriber numbers is coming from lead volume rather than a shift further down the funnel.
4
Spend concentration
Prospecting | Sales Messaging | WA | In-House Content accounted for 44% of this month's spend, with a cost per lead running 4% below the account average. As the largest campaign in the account, it's also doing the most to keep overall costs down.
Recommendations
1
Budget allocation
Retargeting | Messaging | WA | EN CONTENT produced the cheapest leads this month at RM8.75, compared to RM22.48 for Prospecting | Messaging | WA | CN CONTENT, a meaningful gap between two campaigns on the same platform. We'd recommend shifting some budget from the latter into the former next month and watching whether the cost advantage holds as spend increases.
2
Lead engagement quality
44.4% of the leads reached this month replied back the same day, down from 47.3% last month. A same-day reply is usually a sign of stronger intent, so this dip is worth watching, we'd recommend testing a sharper opening message or narrowing the audience toward higher-intent segments to help bring it back up.
3
Creative refresh vs scale
SmallStudio-CN was this month's strongest performer, with 94 leads at RM10.93 each. 4 of the account's 14 active creatives are each spending under 2% of budget with little to show for it, we'd recommend shifting that spend toward the top performers and retiring or refreshing the underperforming 4.
4
Video content format
Only 38% of 3-second plays reach the 25% watched mark, the steepest drop in the funnel, and just 7% watch to the end. Since most of the loss happens right at the start, we'd recommend prioritising a stronger opening hook on new creative over changes to the middle or end of the video.

Strategy Note — September 2026

1. Revive Meta Website Conversion campaign
CRM data confirms it's profitable, restarting it. New creatives are in to find the format that drives the cheapest cost per registration.

2. Google SEM search pack
Keyword targeting and ad copy, aiming for mid-month delivery.

3. Google Tag Manager event setup
Configure conversion tracking so Google's SEM algorithm has real data to learn from and optimize against. Also targeting mid-month.
